# Adrian Carballo

> Product Designer based in Jacksonville, FL, designing since 2019. Focus: B2B, AI and IoT products with clear workflows, readable data and consistent interfaces that scale.

## About and resume

- [About and resume](https://ekko94.github.io/portfolio/about.html): Experience at Sorba.ai, Interamplify, QA-BIT and Guajiritos, education and how Adrian works. CV (PDF, one page): https://ekko94.github.io/portfolio/assets/Adrian-Carballo-CV.pdf

## Case studies

- [Vision: From forms to a node canvas](https://ekko94.github.io/portfolio/vision.html): Introduced a node canvas within a guided setup for configuring computer vision workflows in IoT Unified, replacing a long wizard of technical forms with a visible pipeline. Research of node-based tools, developer-driven iteration, launched after four months. Usability with end users is still to be measured.
- [Sorbot: AI guidance, inside the workflow](https://ekko94.github.io/portfolio/sorbot.html): Designed a dedicated AI assistant and an embedded chat inside node configuration, with a visible model selector and a verify-responses reminder. About two months; effect on task success still to be evaluated with users.

- [AI Trainer: Designing the dataset module](https://ekko94.github.io/portfolio/trainer.html): Sole product designer for about four months on Sorba's AI Trainer (formerly ML Trainer): the dataset forms and flows, available in the Sorba demo in the earlier visual style, and a proposed redesign of the overview, dataset list, versions, explorer and warnings with a new visual style. Feedback came from developers and the e-commerce team; no end-user validation or usage data is claimed.

## Other work (case studies not yet published)

- IoT Unified: redesign of Asset Collection, one of the largest nodes of the platform.
